entities.summary: The Immaculate Conception Cathedral, officially the Cathedral of the Immaculate Conception, is a Catholic cathedral located on Frangon street in the city of Thessaloniki, in Central Macedonia region of Greece. The church follows the Roman or Latin Rite and functions as the seat of the Apostolic Vicariate of Thessaloniki that, as of December 2025, was sede vacante.
